target: 03 Requirements and specifications/PRD/Recovery Workbench PRD P2 rwb-integration v1.md

fixes.old: hold neither attempt count nor interval in code (GAP-1540; ASM-2669).
fixes.new: hold neither attempt count nor interval in code (GAP-1540; ASM-2669). The configuration in force holds a maximum of 3 attempts and retry intervals of 5, 15 and 45 minutes (FSD P2 v3 AC-EXC-P2-001-01); these are interface configuration values, not a product rule.

(GAP-1537; ASM-2666). The bank scheduler owns the window, its opening time and any re-run; the service owns the attempt ladder inside the window, the exception state and the owner task; the single owner of the retry count is left to DL11 (Q-P2-02).

fixes.old: | Task queue `rwb-integration`; activity steps; no Temporal Schedule of this service | Arch v5 slides 16 and 44; ADR-016; DP-10 |
fixes.new: | Job owners per the Ownership Map: JOB-10 is owned by rwb-comms (P6), JOB-13 by rwb-decision (P7) and JOB-15 by rwb-reporting (P9); rwb-integration registers no Temporal Schedule and provides the delivery capability the owning service calls | Ownership Map v1; GAP-1536; ASM-2665 |

fixes.old: Each requirement traces to a BRD non-functional requirement; a target the source does not state is held open and never invented (ASM-2672).
fixes.new: Every service inherits the programme targets. Interface-level file size, throughput, window length and daily volume: Not specified in the source documents (GAP-1544); they stay open under DL11 with the §R9 placeholder.

fixes.old: Owned by S9 rwb-partner and P5 rwb-document (GAP-1547; ASM-2675)
fixes.new: Owned by S9 rwb-partner and P5 rwb-document, which keep their own contracts; P2 carries no requirement for them, and the FSD P2 v3 transport sentence for these channels is superseded (GAP-1547; ASM-2675)
